title: Noa-21 angle set, both directions with headroom
source_idea: noa-21 was chosen by the operator, not by the score, which ranked it fourth. Its measured weakness is real and specific: one seed in three collapsed to 0.579, and the direct direction rotated shallowly while the mirrored pass reached a full profile in one take. So the set is shot with headroom in both directions and only admitted clips are kept.
